routes.claim: Every durable observation exact-rebuilds from a live v2.7 audit package before write.
routes.passCondition: Valid input writes the exact validated audit; changed input or receipt writes nothing and returns a typed refusal.
routes.primarySurface: focused runtime assertions with valid and tampered packages
routes.counterevidence: any mismatch is admitted or any failed admission creates a manifest or record

routes.claim: A stored observation reloads after a process restart without the source or retention roots.
routes.passCondition: A separate process reloads the byte-identical observation and chain summary after both compared roots are removed from a synthetic test directory.
routes.primarySurface: fresh child process after bounded synthetic root removal
routes.counterevidence: reload touches or requires either compared root, changes the observation, or succeeds from a corrupt chain
routes.secondarySurface: canonical record bytes and digest inspection

routes.claim: The local observation log is append-only, contiguous, digest-bound, exclusive-created, and file-fsynced.
routes.passCondition: Stored bytes equal canonical receipts; gaps, corruption, extras, overwrites, stale locks, and concurrent writes fail closed.
routes.counterevidence: a corrupt or gapped namespace reloads, a record is replaced, or both concurrent writers succeed
routes.secondarySurface: source inspection plus clean detached replay

routes.claim: Observation capture and reload grant no execution, review, identity, adoption, promotion, merge, or CANON authority.
routes.passCondition: Closed receipts and contracts contain only false authority flags and autonomousActionCount zero; wrong or absent confirmation cannot write.
routes.counterevidence: any affirmative authority flag, action side effect, identity claim, or write without the exact confirmation

routes.claim: Local observation survival is not external retention or protected monotonic continuity.
routes.passCondition: The suite demonstrates origin-root loss survival and separately demonstrates that joint three-root replacement can form another internally exact local history.
routes.counterevidence: artifact or documentation claims external operation, protected monotonicity, rollback prevention, or global continuity

routes.claim: The additive leaf does not regress inherited Workshop checks.
routes.passCondition: Focused, inherited retained-module, evidence, required AGENTS, and detached replay commands all exit zero.
routes.counterevidence: any nonzero exit or changed stable input during a run
routes.secondarySurface: final shared-workspace snapshot and detached worktree rerun
